reviewPriorities: Check correctness, gaps, and completeness against the stated task before considering secondary improvements.
Check consistency with existing decisions, scope, terminology, and related artifacts. Say Unknown when context is insufficient.
Respect source provenance. Do not turn missing source access into an absence claim.
Require explicit current-turn authorization for shared-system writes.
Check realistic workflows, failure handling, security-sensitive paths, and material tests.

figjam: Check the final board outcome, not only source code or payload generation.
Check source and status labels, terminology, hierarchy, decisions, open questions, and next actions.
Require distinct evidence for payload generation and import or rendering.
If no rendered image was inspected, keep visual quality Unknown.
